timeline.blocker: Bank account not seeded with Aadhaar. Fix this to unlock ₹2,000 installment.

faq.question: When will I get the next installment?
faq.answer: PM Kisan installments are released every 4 months. The next installment of ₹2,000 is expected in December/June, provided your verification is complete.

faq.question: Why was my previous installment rejected?
faq.answer: Your previous installment may have been rejected due to incomplete Aadhaar-Bank seeding. Please visit your bank branch to link your Aadhaar with your bank account.

faq.question: What is the premium rate for farmers?
faq.answer: The premium paid by farmers is capped at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
